Our client is looking for an Assistant Engineer – Renewable Energy to support the execution of solar power projects. The ideal candidate will have practical experience in solar PV installations, particularly in ground-mounted and rooftop systems. The role will involve coordinating site activities, monitoring installation progress, resolving technical issues and ensuring the successful implementation of solar projects. The candidate must be comfortable travelling to different project sites.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Coordinate and monitor solar PV installation activities at various project sites, covering both rooftop and ground-mounted systems.
Supervise site teams and installation technicians to ensure work is completed according to project timelines and required quality standards.
Carry out site assessments and evaluate installation requirements, including equipment placement, mounting arrangements and electrical connections.
Monitor the installation of solar panels, inverters, support structures and associated electrical components.
Identify installation-related challenges and coordinate with relevant technical teams to implement appropriate solutions.
Ensure materials, tools and equipment required for installation are available at project sites.
Conduct quality checks throughout the installation process and ensure compliance with relevant technical and safety requirements.
Coordinate with project managers, contractors, suppliers and other stakeholders to ensure timely project completion.
Assist with system testing, performance checks and commissioning activities before project handover.
Maintain site progress updates, installation records and technical reports.
Undertake regular visits to project locations and provide on-site technical support as required.

PRE - REQUISITES:



Diploma, Higher National Diploma or Degree in Electrical Engineering, Electrical & Electronic Engineering or a related technical discipline.
Minimum 3-5 years of relevant experience in electrical engineering, solar installation or renewable energy projects.
Practical exposure to both ground-mounted and rooftop solar PV installations is essential.
Experience in handling installation activities, site coordination and technical supervision.
Understanding of solar PV equipment, electrical connections, inverters and mounting systems.
Ability to identify and resolve basic technical and installation-related issues.
Good knowledge of electrical safety practices and site work procedures.
Willingness to travel to different project sites as required.
Strong coordination, communication and problem-solving abilities.
Ability to work independently and manage multiple site activities.
